title: Function revealment bound
statement: Let the input alphabet be finite, let $g$ be a function on length-$n$ inputs over that alphabet, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on the alphabet, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree computing $g$. The infimum of revealment over all randomized decision trees computing $g$ is at most the revealment of $T$ under the product input distribution with marginal $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: A function on length-$n$ inputs over the alphabet
A probability distribution on the input alphabet
A randomized decision tree computing the function
